title.en: An ontology about medical devices and their risks

description.en:
dc:description

This is an ontology on the European catalog of medical devices of high risk and in vitro diagnostic devices. Based on the MDR Regulation (EU 2017/745) and the IVDR Regulation (EU 2017/746)
